user.title: TP-Link Third-Party Compatibility
user.description: Sign in with your Kasa / TP-Link account. Credentials are stored locally and used only to keep Third-Party Compatibility on. Manage your account at [tp-link.com]({account_url}).

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.description: Enter the verification code TP-Link just sent to {email}. This device is then trusted, so future sign-ins skip this step.

error.invalid_mfa: That verification code was not accepted. Request a new one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TP-Link cloud.

data.auto_heal: Automatically re-enable compatibility when the account setting is turned off
